title: A 31-character term prints in full on modern invoices and estimates
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the organization uses the modern invoice design.
  • Make sure customer A holds the shop's own term A, which has a 31-character name. Work order 1 for customer A has an estimate and an invoice.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open the printed estimate of work order 1.
  2. Open the printed invoice of work order 1.
  3. Open the work order print of work order 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The terms show every character of term A, without clipping or "...".

Step 2:

  • The terms show every character of term A, without clipping.

Step 3:

  • The work order print does not show the credit term at all.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
